exact_statement: For all 256 labelled three-bit Boolean cores v in F=-1 on x=0,a=1, v on x=1,b=1, +1 otherwise, fix the original canonical occupancy reference M and A=KL(P||M), query a, and explicitly book actual a-child product references. Suppose the original expected child Sbar=mean(4I-H), certified positive, is otherwise unspent. Thereafter allow any branch-dependent adaptive sequence of the five remaining physical coordinates and any stopping cut, with actual coherent transport and explicit child-product resets, fairly extending the kernel on all source-zero/reference-positive fibers. For product-reference nodes define K=TC, D_i=O_i+mean K_child-K, and T=max(0,max_i([D_i]_++mean T_child)), with dimension-zero T=0. The exact rational interval certificate proves W=[D_a]_++mean T(a children)<Sbar/20 for every core. The nonnegative potential R_root=A+W and R=K+T thereafter has drift at least O at every admitted query, hence E R_tau+E sum O<=A+W for every policy and bounded stopping cut. Its full terminal reference cross-entropy is retained: E CE_tau+E sum O<=A+W+E H_tau, with M at the unqueried root and actual product references later. A core194 physical branch of reach1/8 has R_child=1 and increase>1/4. This closes all adaptive histories of this finite interface only; arbitrary-core account eligibility and full FEI remain open.
